description_input:
Set in place rig components and heavy loads, Draw works, A-Frame, Derrick and
strung blocks. Raised derrick. Rigged up equipment.
Set in Top Drive and track, wind walls and nippled up equipment.

Picked up 112 joints (37 stands) 5" DP and stood back in derrick. Strapp.ed, OD, ID,
FN 24 joints of HWDP and nine 8" DC
Picked up 7 stands of HWDP and 3 stands of 8" DC
Trouble shot and replaced swivel packing. X
Rigged up and ran 13-3/8", 54.5 ppf, J-55 buttress casing with shoe set at 381'.
Rigged up cementers and circulated hole clean.
Waited on cement. Cut off 20" conductor and 13.375" casing.
Installed valves on well head and tightened.

Insstalled spool, mud cross, double gates, annular, flow spool, choke line, choke
hose and torqued all flanges.
Tested BOPE system, emailed results to DWR (Jim Goddard).
Ran in the hole with 12-1/4" Bit.
Drilled out float, shoe and drilled 12-1/4" hole from 380' to 390'.
Pulled out of the well bore.
Made up Bit #3 with mud motor and tools.
Ran in hole and installed rotating well head.
Drilled 12-1/4" hole rotating and sliding from 390' to 2,226'
Drilled 12-1/4" hole rotating and sliding from 2,226' to 2,500'.
Wiper trip to 380' with tight hole at 2,300'.
Pulled out of the well bore for new bit and motor.
Laid down tools and picked up new bit with mud motor.
Encountered tight spot and reamed 12-1/4" hole from 2,331' to 3,305'.
Wiped hole from 3500' to 2000' and backed to bottom at 3500'.
Wiped hole from 3500' to 2000' and back to bottom at 3500'.
Pulled out of the hole and laid down BHA.
Cleared rig floor for casing run.

Waited on Power Tongs. (Power tong truck had the rear end go out, waited on new
truck).

Rigged up and ran 83 joints of 9.625" 36 ppf, J-55, LT&C casing with shoe set at
3488'.
Rigged down casers and circulated well bore clean.

Break stack at well head. Lift stack, cleaned out cement from well head. Set slips in
well head around 9-5/8" casing. Set down stack and nipped up. Cleaned BOPE
stack of cement.
Tested BOPE. Cleaned flow line of cement.
Strapped drill collars, made up bit.

Cleaned out cement stringers from 3,200' to 3,414' and drilled out baffle plate,
cement and shoe at 3,488' and cement to 3,500'.
Picked up drill pipe single and stood back in derrick.
Strapped collars and made up tools.
Pulled out of the hole laying down bit and tools.
Made up bit, directional tools and ran in the hole.
Circulated bottoms up in preparation for trip out of hole.
Pulled out of the hole and laid down bit and mud motor.
Made up new bit and mud motor, ran in the hole to 5,083'.
Filled pipe and washed to bottom at 5,143'.
Pulled out of the well bore laying down bit, mud motor and tools.
Made up tools and ran in the hole.
Pulled out of the well bore with broken shaft on mud motor.
Made up bit and new BHA. Ran in the hole to shoe at 3,512'.
Pulled out of the well bore laying down BHA and bit.
Made up Bit #11 and new BHA. Ran in the hole to 7,141'.
Washed and reamed 8-3/4" hole from 7,141' to 7,208'.
Pulled out of the well bore laying down bit and BHA.
Made up mud hammer and BHA.
Ran in the hole with BHA.

Fill pipe and test hammer, pulled out to trouble shoot Mud Hammer, changed out jet
and mud orifice.
Ran in the hole with mud hammer
Ran in the well bore with Mud Hammer to 5,790'.
BHA stuck at 5,790' and worked string. Spotted torqueaze and worked pipe free.
Pulled out of the hole laying down reamers.
Ran in the hole with mud motor.
Reamed 8-3/4" hole from 5,790' to 5,850'. (Tagged up at 5,790')
Ran in the hole to bottom at 7,620'.
Pulled out of the hole laying down mud hammer and tools.
Made up bit and reaming assembly, RIH to 5,703'.
Ran in the hole un-obstructed from 5,983' to 7,600'.
Washed and reamed 8-3/4" hole from 7,600' to 7,627'.
Pulled out of the well bore laying down BHA.
Made up mud hammer and ran in the hole to 5500'.
Pulled out of the hole laying down mud hammer and tools.
Ran mud hammer in mouse hole and tested hammer. Hammer would not fire.
Made up bit and tools. Ran in hole to 3,561'.
Slipped and cut 100' to drilling line.
Ran in the hole to bottom at 7,666'.
Pulled out of the hole from 8,000' to 7,750'.
Pulled out of the hole laying down bit and tools.

Tested 2 mud hammers in "Mouse Hole" with mud and water. Hammers worked with
water but not with mud.
Made up bit and BHA 15 and staged in the hole 2,200-7,651' cooling well bore.

Ran in the hole and encountered tight spot at 7651', jarred drill string free and worked
tight spot to 8,188'.
Rotary drilled 8-3/4" hole from 9025' to TD of 9145'.
Pulled out of the hole laying down bit, tools and drill collars.
Made up logging bit, float and tools on HWDP and ran in the hole to 9145'.

Rigged up loggers and picked up tools. Ran in to bottom through drill pipe with wire
line.
Rigged down wire line unit and pump in sub.
Pulled out of the hole with Triple Combo and Gyro 30'/minute.
Rigged down loggers and download data.
Circulate to cool well bore for wire-line coring.
Rigged up loggers and run side core logs. Rigged down loggers.
Ran in the well bore to 3,489'.
Slip and cut 85' of drilling line.
Ran in the hole to TD at 9,145'.
Laid down drill pipe and heavy wall drill pipe, bit and subs.

Nippled down BOPE and picked up with rig. Cut off casing and removed slips,
installed BOPE.

Rigged up and ran 5-1/2" 17 ppf, L-80, Buttress Liner equipped with Fiber Optics
cable attached to the liner.
Ran 5-1/2" 17 ppf, L-88, Buttress casing equipped with fiber optic cable to 7,280'.
Circulated to cool and clean well bore.
Ran 5-1/2" 17 ppf, L-80, Buttress casing equipped with fiber optic cable to 8,192'.
Ran 5-1/2" 17 ppf, L-80, Buttress casing equipped with fiber optic cable to 9,130'.

Closed Annular Preventer and pumped 330 barrels down back side to clear annulus
of cement.

Waited on cement for "Top Down" cement job and tools for clean out. Cut and laid
down 25' of 5-1/2" liner at KB level. Removed flow line and check valve in kill line.
Made preparations for Top Down cement job.

Waited on cement. Cut off casing and laid down cementing equipment. Rigged
down casing equipment and unloaded 2-7/8" drill pipe, 4" drill collars and running
tools.
Nippled down BOPE and removed 9-5/8" casing head.
Flanged up flow line, installed chains on flow nipple, set catwalk and mouse hole.
Rigged up tongs for 2-7/8" drill pipe and tools, strapped drill pipe.
Made up bit collars and tools. Ran in the well bore and tagged top of cement at 731'.
Picked up 10 stands of drill pipe and stood back in derrick.
Drilled out cement float at 820' and drilled out cement fro 820' to 1709'.

Pulled out of the well bore and changed BHA for mud motor and PDC bit. Ran in the
hole.
Cleaned out cement from 3,700' to 6,238' at 2400 hours.
Pumped sweep and circulated well bore clean.
Pulled out of the hole laying down 4" drill collars and bit.
Made up bit, casing scraper, bumper sub and ran in the hole scraping Liner.
Displace the mud in the hole with 200 bbl fresh water
Displace the water in the hole with 266 bbl Biocide water
POH laying down all 2-7/8" drill pipe

Remove flow line and cut casing at ground level, separate cross over spools, load out
3rd truck of rental tools and 4th truck w/ motors to Casper

Weld on wellhead and install master valve. Weld on weldalet and install threaded
valve
